questions.stem: What is the function of the muscles in our body?
choices: They help in the movement of the body
They help in the circulation of blood
They help in the digestion of food
They help in the production of hormones
questions.solution: Muscles are responsible for the movement of the body because they contract and relax, allowing different parts of the body to move. The other options are incorrect because blood circulation is primarily handled by the heart and blood vessels, digestion involves the digestive system, and hormone production is managed by glands.

questions.stem: Which part of the digestive system is responsible for the digestion of carbohydrates?
questions.solution: The mouth is responsible for the digestion of carbohydrates because saliva contains enzymes that break down carbohydrates. The stomach digests proteins, the large intestine absorbs water, and the liver produces bile, which aids in fat digestion but not carbohydrates.

questions.stem: Which type of muscles work according to our will?
questions.solution: Skeletal muscles are the type that work according to our will because they are under conscious control and are responsible for body movements. Cardiac muscles are found in the heart and work automatically without conscious effort. Smooth muscles are found in internal organs and also function involuntarily. Involuntary muscles is a general term for muscles that do not work according to our will, such as cardiac and smooth muscles.

hi.stem: कौन सा पेशी प्रकार हमारी इच्छा के अनुसार कार्य करता है?
hi.solution: कंकाल पेशी हमारी इच्छा के अनुसार कार्य करती है क्योंकि वे जागरूक नियंत्रण में होती हैं और शरीर के गतियों के लिए जिम्मेदार होती हैं। हृदय पेशी दिल में पाई जाती है और जागरूक प्रयास के बिना स्वयं चलती है। चिकनी पेशी आंतरिक अंगों में पाई जाती है और अस्वच्छेदी रूप से कार्य करती है। अस्वच्छेदी पेशी एक सामान्य शब्द है जो पेशी के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो हमारी इच्छा के अनुसार कार्य नहीं करती है, जैसे कि हृदय और चिकनी पेशी।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Hindi medical terminology.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a function of the liver?
questions.solution: The liver produces bile, which is essential for breaking down fats during digestion. Absorbing nutrients occurs in the small intestine, churning food is the stomach's role, and breaking down proteins is primarily done by the stomach and small intestine. Therefore, producing bile is the correct function of the liver.

questions.stem: What happens if the cardiac muscles do not move?
choices: The brain will not function properly
questions.solution: Cardiac muscles are responsible for the continuous contraction and relaxation of the heart, which is necessary for pumping blood. If they do not move, the heart cannot function, leading to it stopping. The other options are incorrect because body weakness, digestion, and brain function are not directly dependent on the movement of cardiac muscles.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a function of the digestive system?
questions.solution: The digestive system's primary function is to absorb nutrients into the blood after breaking down food. Producing hormones is a function of the endocrine system, controlling body temperature is managed by the integumentary and nervous systems, and regulating heart rate is the role of the cardiovascular and nervous systems.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a voluntary muscle?
questions.solution: Voluntary muscles are those that can be controlled consciously, such as those used for movement like chewing. Jaw muscle is an example of a voluntary muscle because it is under conscious control. Heart muscle, stomach muscle, and intestinal muscle are involuntary, meaning they work automatically without conscious effort.

questions.stem: Which part of the digestive system absorbs water from the undigested food?
questions.solution: The large intestine absorbs water from the undigested food, leaving behind solid waste. The small intestine is primarily responsible for nutrient absorption, the stomach breaks down food with acid and enzymes, and the liver produces bile to aid in fat digestion.

questions.stem: Why is the small intestine considered the primary site for nutrient absorption?
choices: It has a large surface area due to villi
It is the longest part of the digestive system
It is connected to the liver
questions.solution: The small intestine is considered the primary site for nutrient absorption because it has a large surface area due to villi, which increases the efficiency of absorption. While it is long and connected to the liver, these features do not directly contribute to the absorption of nutrients. The production of digestive enzymes is not the main function related to absorption.

questions.stem: Why do muscles in the stomach not get tired easily?
choices: They are made of strong tissue
They are controlled by the brain
questions.solution: The correct answer is that they are involuntary muscles. Involuntary muscles, like those in the stomach, work automatically and continuously without needing conscious effort, which helps them not tire easily. Voluntary muscles, which are controlled by the brain, require conscious effort and can become fatigued more quickly. Strong tissue or fat surrounding the muscles do not directly explain why they do not tire.

hi.stem: पेट के मांसपेशियां आसानी से थक नहीं जाती हैं क्यों?
choices: उन्हें मजबूत ऊतक बना होता है
उन्हें मस्तिष्क द्वारा नियंत्रित किया जाता है
उन्हें वसा द्वारा घिरा होता है
hi.solution: सही उत्तर यह है कि वे अस्वच्छेदी मांसपेशियां होती हैं। अस्वच्छेदी मांसपेशियां, जैसे कि पेट में, स्वतः और लगातार बिना जागरूक प्रयास के काम करती हैं, जिससे उन्हें थकान आसानी से नहीं होती है। स्वच्छेदी मांसपेशियां, जो मस्तिष्क द्वारा नियंत्रित होती हैं, जागरूक प्रयास की आवश्यकता होती है और जल्दी थक जाती हैं। मजबूत ऊतक या मांसपेशियों के आसपास की वसा उन्हें थकने के बिना रहने के कारण की व्याख्या सीधे नहीं करती है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology for biological concepts.

mr.stem: मज्जा च्या मांसपेशी ला थकलेले का लक्षात येत नाही?
choices: त्या दृढ ताकदीच्या ऊतीने बनलेल्या असतात
mr.solution: सही उत्तर हे त्या अस्वच्छेत्री मांसपेशी असतात. मज्जा मधील अस्वच्छेत्री मांसपेशी विना जाणीवेने आणि सतत कार्य करतात, ज्यामुळे त्यांना थकलेले लक्षात येत नाही. मेंदू द्वारे नियंत्रित केलेल्या स्वच्छेत्री मांसपेशी ला जाणीवेने कार्य करावे लागते आणि त्यांना जलद थकलेले लक्षात येते. दृढ ऊती किंवा चरबी घेरलेल्या मांसपेशी ला थकलेले लक्षात येण्याचे कारण व्यक्त करत नाहीत.
